OrientIdentity.text: The upright picture: the identity matrix.

OrientOfOp.text: The matrix of Rotate left, Rotate right or Flip: the same movement RotatePointAbout gives a point about the origin. Any other operation gives the identity.

OrientMul.text: Two orientations one after the other: the matrix of doing First and then Second.

OrientInverse.text: The way back from an orientation (its transpose: these matrices turn and flip without stretching).

OrientSame.text: Whether two orientations are the same.

OrientIsIdentity.text: Whether an orientation is the upright one.

OrientSwapsAxes.text: Whether the orientation turns the picture a quarter, so that its width and height change places.

OrientFromTurns.text: The orientation that is a flip left to right (or none) followed by some quarter turns to the right.

params.Turns: how many quarter turns to the right (taken round to 0 to 3)

OrientToTurns.text: Takes an orientation apart into the flip (or none) and the quarter turns to the right that make it, which is how the file keeps it.
OrientToTurns.returns: False if the matrix is none of the eight orientations

params.Turns: receives the quarter turns to the right, 0 to 3
params.Mirror: receives whether it is flipped first

OrientIndex.text: The orientation as a number 0 to 7 (the quarter turns, plus 4 if flipped), for keeping a picture drawn in each of them.
OrientIndex.returns: the number, or -1 if the matrix is none of the eight

OrientedSize.text: The size of a picture once it is in an orientation: the same, or width and height changed places.

params.W: the width of the picture as it is
params.OutW: receives the width in the orientation
params.OutH: receives the height in the orientation
